senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of און , v. אָוֶן) to press, oppress, wrong, v. אָנָה.—אוֹנָן one who feels grieved, mourner, esp. Onan, mourner before the burial of a kinsman, contrad. to אָבֵל; v. אֲנִינָה.
units: <cite ref="Moed Katan 14b:11">M. Kat. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>מקדיב א׳</he> may officiate at sacrifices though being an Onan.—Pl. <he>אוֹנָנִין</he>.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 47b:3">Snh. 47ᵇ</cite> <he>לא היו מתאבלין אלא א׳</he> they observed no mourning ceremonies but lived in silent and retired mourning.—Fem. <he>אוֹנֶנֶת</he>.
Keth. 53ᵃ.—Denom. אָנִין complaining, fastidious, feeble. Pl. אֲנִינֵי הדעת fastidious of taste, easily taking an aversion, delicate.

senses.gloss: to feel wronged, complain of being overreached, v. אָנָה.
